q: The IUPAC name of HCOOH is ethanoic acid. (2024)
e: The IUPAC name of HCOOH is methanoic acid, while ethanoic acid is CH3COOH.

q: Plastics that are thrown into the sea endanger marine animals. (2024)
e: Plastic waste in oceans threatens marine life through ingestion and entanglement.

q: The main component of nail polish remover is carboxylic acid. (2024)
e: The main component of nail polish remover is propanone (acetone) or ethyl acetate, not a carboxylic acid.

q: Each functional group has characteristic absorption range of wavenumbers. (2024)
e: Different functional groups absorb specific frequencies/wavenumbers of infrared light.

q: Ethanoic acid is manufactured by the fermentation of ethanol. (2025)
e: Ethanoic acid is manufactured by the oxidation of ethanol, whereas fermentation produces ethanol from sugars.

q: Electrons in the infrared radiation region can cause bond vibrations in molecules. (2025)
e: Infrared radiation affects molecular bond vibrations, not electron excitation levels.

q: An ether is an organic compound with an O atom bonded to two alkyl groups. (2025)
e: Ethers have the general structure R-O-R', where oxygen connects two alkyl or aryl groups.

q: Nylon and paracetamol are examples of amides. (2025)
e: Both nylon (a polyamide) and paracetamol contain amide functional groups.

q: Polymer which consists of only one kind of monomers is called a copolymer. (2025)
e: A polymer made from a single type of monomer is called a homopolymer.

q: The compound RNH₂ is an example of a secondary amine. (2025)
e: RNH₂ is a primary amine because the nitrogen atom is attached to only one alkyl group.

q: The polymer Styrofoam is used in non-stick frying pans. (2025)
e: Teflon (polytetrafluoroethylene) is used for non-stick frying pans, whereas Styrofoam is used for insulation and packaging.

q: Photons in the infrared radiation region can cause bond vibrations in molecules. (2025)
e: Infrared photons possess energy that matches the vibrational modes of chemical bonds.

q: Condensation polymers often have higher molecular masses than addition polymers. (2025)
e: Addition polymers frequently achieve much higher molecular masses than condensation polymers.

q: Light atoms vibrate at higher frequencies than heavy atoms. (2025)
e: Lower mass results in a higher vibrational frequency for a given bond strength.

q: Bending is a vibration that occurs along the bond line and changes the bond length. (2025)
e: Bending changes the bond angle, while stretching changes the bond length along the bond axis.

q: Nickel is used to treat or prevent anemia. (2025)
e: Iron supplements are used to treat or prevent anemia.

q: A ketone does not give precipitate with Fehling's solution. (2025)
e: Ketones are resistant to mild oxidation and do not reduce Fehling's solution.

q: The addition of ammonia to a carboxylic acid forms an amide. (2025)
e: Carboxylic acids react with ammonia to form ammonium salts which yield amides upon heating.

q: Fehling's solution is an acidic solution containing copper(II) ions. (2025)
e: Fehling's solution is an alkaline solution containing complexed copper(II) ions.

q: Aldehydes and ketones are organic compounds which contain the carboxyl group. (2025)
e: Aldehydes and ketones contain the carbonyl group (>C=O), not the carboxyl group (-COOH).

q: Proteins are made from thousands of amino acid polymers. (2025)
e: Proteins are polymers made from amino acid monomers, not from thousands of amino acid polymers.

q: Ketones can be obtained by the elimination of H₂O from two molecules of alcohol. (2025)
e: Ketones are produced by the oxidation of secondary alcohols.

q: Transesterification is the reaction of an ester with an alcohol to form a different ester. (2025)
e: Transesterification exchanges the alkoxy group of an ester with an alcohol to form a new ester.

q: In the formation of polyester, dehydration reaction would join two subunits together. (2025)
e: Polyesters are formed via condensation reactions where water is eliminated as monomers join.

q: Hydrolysis of ester leads to the formation of alcohol and carboxylic acid in a basic medium. (2025)
e: In a basic medium, ester hydrolysis produces an alcohol and a carboxylate salt.

q: To produce a propane, 2-propanol must be heated with an oxidising agent. (2025)
e: Oxidizing 2-propanol yields propanone.

q: Terylene is used to make disposable containers. (2025)
e: Terylene is a synthetic polyester fiber used primarily for textiles, whereas materials like polystyrene make disposable containers.

q: When ethanol is treated with a limited amount of sulphuric acid and heated to 100°C, diethyl ether and water are formed. (2025)
e: Formation of diethyl ether from ethanol requires heating at 140°C with excess ethanol in the presence of acid.

q: Photodegradable plastics are made from monomers derived directly from plant materials such as polylactic acid (PLA). (2025)
e: Plastics derived directly from renewable plant sources like PLA are biodegradable plastics, not photodegradable.

q: Multiple bonds vibrate at higher frequencies than single bonds. (2025)
e: Multiple bonds have greater bond strength and higher force constants, resulting in higher vibrational frequencies.

q: The biologically important proteins and nucleic acids are made up of macromolecular units. (2025)
e: Proteins and nucleic acids are biopolymers composed of large macromolecular chains.

q: Methoxymethane and methoxyethane are colourless gases at room temperature. (2025)
e: Both low-molecular-weight ethers exist as gases at standard room conditions.

q: Fehling's solution is an alkaline solution containing copper (I) ions. (2025)
e: Fehling's solution contains copper(II) ions, which get reduced to copper(I) oxide.

q: Amides are found in many molecules essential to life, such as amino acids hormones, and DNA. (2026)
e: DNA consists of nucleotide chains rather than amide linkages.

q: Light atoms vibrate at higher frequencies than heavier atoms and multiple bonds vibrate at lower frequencies than single bonds. (2026)
e: Multiple bonds vibrate at higher frequencies than single bonds due to stronger bond constants.

q: Many plastic toys, bags and buckets are made of polyethene. (2026)
e: Polyethene is widely manufactured for everyday durable plastic items like bags and containers.

q: Methoxymethane and methoxyethane are colourless gasses at high temperature. (2026)
e: They are colourless gases at room temperature.

q: Different functional groups produce bond absorptions at different locations and intensities on the IR spectrum. (2026)
e: Each functional group displays unique vibrational energy signatures in infrared spectroscopy.

q: Butanal contains carboxyl functional group. (2026)
e: Butanal is an aldehyde containing a carbonyl group (-CHO), not a carboxyl group.
